blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Streaming video understanding requires a model to decide not only what to answer but also when to answer. Evidence arrives progressively, and recent benchmarks identify premature responses, issued before the queried event has concluded, as a recurring failure mode. Existing approaches often learn response timing through additional training, while training-free alternatives typically rely on scalar gating signals that do not explicitly represent when an answer becomes final. We organize chunk-wise streaming errors into three patterns: sampling variation can make an answer unstable, a stable answer may lack support in the observed video, or an answer may be supported by the current evidence while the event remains unfinished. We propose PACE (Plan, Attend, Check, and Emit), a training-free framework designed around these three failure modes. Given a question, PACE drafts a plan specifying what to observe and what will signal completion. As the stream unfolds, it invokes an off-the-shelf video LLM at informative moments, evaluates each draft for stability, grounding in its cited frames, and completion, and records verified observations in an event ledger. Experiments on ProactiveVideoQA and OVO-Bench Forward show that PACE improves over the official protocols by up to 5.9 average PAUC points and 6.2 average accuracy points across proprietary and open-source backbones, yielding state-of-the-art performance.
blocks.zh: 流畅的视频理解要求一个模型不仅决定答案,而且决定何时回答。 证据逐渐到来,最近的基准确定,在被询问事件结束前发布的反应过早,是一种反复发生的失败模式。 现有办法往往通过额外培训学习反应时间,而无培训的替代办法通常依赖在答复成为最终答案时没有明确代表的标尺标记信号。 我们把分块流出的错误组织成三种模式: 采样变异可以使一个答案不稳定, 稳定的答案可能在被观测到的视频中缺乏支持, 或者在事件未完成时,一个答案可能会得到当前证据的支持. 我们提议PACE(计划、出席、检查和Emit),这是围绕这三种失败模式设计的无培训框架。 面对一个问题,计算机设备行动伙伴关系起草了一项计划,其中具体规定了观察的内容和表示完成的内容。 随着溪流的展开,它引用了现成的视频LLM在信息化时刻,评价每个草稿的稳定性,在其引用的框中定位,完成,并在事件分类账中记录经核实的观测结果. 关于主动VideoQA和OVO-Bench Forward的实验显示,PACE比官方协议改进了最高5.9个PAUC平均点和6.2个跨专有和开源主干线的平均准确点,产生了最先进的性能.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Video large language models are increasingly being considered for live-streaming settings, including narrating an egocentric camera, monitoring a surveillance feed, and answering questions during playback [ 4 , 22 , 40 , 12 , 42 ] . In these settings, video arrives continuously and interaction takes place while the content is still unfolding. Unlike offline video question answering, where the full video is available before inference, streaming requires a model to decide not only what to answer but also when to answer and when to remain silent, as relevant evidence may arrive seconds or minutes after a question is asked (Fig. 1 ).
blocks.zh: 视频大语言模型越来越多地被考虑用于现场流媒体设置,包括叙述一个以自我为中心的摄像机,监测监视信号,以及在播放过程中回答问题[4、22、40、12、42]。 在这些环境下,视频持续到来,在内容仍在出现时进行互动. 与线下视频问答不同, 整个视频在推论前即可获得,

blocks.en: Most prior work learns response timing through silence-token objectives, scoring heads, or dedicated decision modules [ 4 , 30 , 28 , 22 , 40 , 23 ] , while existing training-free alternatives gate responses using scalar signals such as an embedding delta or a token-drop ratio [ 15 , 41 ] . These approaches have complementary limitations. Learned timing components are difficult to transfer directly to proprietary black-box models, even though those models perform strongly under naive chunk-wise inference on ProactiveVideoQA [ 29 ] . Scalar gating signals, meanwhile, do not explicitly represent whether the evidence required by a particular question is complete.
blocks.zh: 大多数前期工作通过静音目标、记分头或专用决策模块[4、30、28、22、40、23]学习反应时间,而现有的无培训替代门响应则使用嵌入三角洲或信号投放率等标码信号[15、41]。 这些办法具有互补性。 学到的计时组件很难直接转移到专有黑盒模型,尽管这些模型在天真无邪的分块推断下,对主动视频QA[29]的强烈表现. 同时,Scalar标志并不明确表明某一特定问题所要求的证据是否完整。

blocks.en: Across recent benchmarks, premature answering emerges as a prominent error. OVO-Bench asks a model to withhold its response until enough future evidence has arrived and finds this ability to be the weakest of the three it evaluates [ 20 ] ; StreamingBench and OmniMMI report a related offline-to-streaming gap [ 17 , 31 ] ; and 92.7% of Gemini 3 Pro’s incorrect proactive triggers on IPIBench occur before the queried event has finished [ 15 ] . These results suggest that response timing, rather than visual perception alone, is often the immediate source of error. Self-consistency [ 27 ] does not directly address this issue: for the question in Fig. 1 , when asked mid-recipe, a model may repeatedly answer “two,” which is consistent with the evidence observed so far but incorrect as a final answer because a third seasoning has yet to appear. Finality therefore depends on both the semantics of the question and the progress of the event; agreement among successive answers alone does not establish it.
blocks.zh: 在最近的基准中,过早回答是一个突出错误。 OVO-Bench要求一个模型在足够的未来证据到来之前不回应, 并且发现这种能力是它评价的三种能力中最弱的; Streaming Bench和OmniMMI报告了一个相关的离线到流的缺口[17, 31];92.7%的双子座3 Pro错误的主动触发器在IPI Bench上发生, 这些结果表明,反应时间,而不是光是视觉感知,往往是错误的直接根源。 自我一致[27]并不直接涉及这个问题:对于Fig中的问题. 1,当被问及中复赛时,一个型号可能会反复回答"2",这与迄今为止观察到的证据是一致的,但作为最后答案是不正确的,因为第三季尚未出现. 因此,最终性既取决于问题的语义,也取决于事件的进展;单靠连续的答案之间达成一致并不能确定这一点。

blocks.en: We organize chunk-wise streaming errors into three recurring failure modes: decoding noise, stable answers that lack visual support, and supported but premature answers. Based on this taxonomy, we propose PACE ( P lan, A ttend, C heck, and E mit), a training-free framework that coordinates calls to an off-the-shelf video LLM and applies a corresponding check to each failure mode. Given the question, Plan drafts a watch plan that specifies what to observe and which visual signal will indicate completion; the plan can subsequently be revised under constrained rules. Attend schedules backbone calls at informative moments in the stream. Check evaluates each draft for stability, grounding, and completion: stability voting reduces sensitivity to decoding noise, re-derivation from cited frames targets answers without visual support, and the completion check tests whether a consistent answer is still premature. Emit records replies, supporting evidence, and plan revisions in an event ledger, reducing duplicate outputs and carrying prior evidence forward.
blocks.zh: 我们将块向流错误组织成三个反复出现的故障模式:解码噪声,缺乏视觉支持的稳定答案,以及支持但过早的答案. 基于这个分类法,我们提议PACE(Plan, A tend, Check, and E mit),这是一个无训练框架,它协调一个现成的视频LLM的调用,并对每个故障模式应用相应的检查. 鉴于这个问题,计划起草一个观察计划,其中具体规定了观察的内容以及哪些视觉信号将表明完成;该计划随后可以根据受限制的规则进行修订。 在信息流的瞬间接通主干线电话 检查评价每个草稿的稳定性,搁浅性,完成性:稳定性投票降低了解码噪声的灵敏度,在没有视觉支持的情况下从引用的帧目标答案中重新推断出来,完成检查测试一个一致的答案是否还为时过早. Emit记录答复、佐证证据和计划修订事件分类账,减少重复产出,并将先前证据结转。

blocks.en: Experiments on ProactiveVideoQA and OVO-Bench Forward show that PACE improves over the official protocols by up to 5.9 average PAUC points and 6.2 average accuracy points across proprietary and open-source backbones, yielding state-of-the-art performance.
blocks.zh: 主动视频实验 QA和OVO-Bench Forward显示,PACE在官方协议上改进了最高5.9平均PAUC积分和6.2平均精度积分跨专有和开源主干线,产生了最先进的性能.

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows: • We organize the premature responses of streaming video LLMs into a three-way taxonomy, and identify consistent prematureness as a stream-specific failure that no inspection of the answer itself can detect. • We propose PACE, a training-free and model-agnostic framework whose checks match the taxonomy one-to-one, built around a self-revising watch plan and an auditable event ledger. • PACE achieves state-of-the-art results on ProactiveVideoQA and OVO-Bench Forward across proprietary and open-source backbones.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献如下: 我们把流式视频LLMS的不成熟反应组织成一个三向分类法,并将一贯的不成熟现象确定为流式特定故障,无法检查答案本身。 我们提议PACE是一个免费的模型不可知框架,它的检查与分类学的一对一相符,它围绕一个自我审查的观察计划和一个可审计的事件分类账构建。 • 计算机设备行动伙伴关系在跨专有和开放源码主干线上取得主动视频QA和OVO-Bench前进的最新成果。

blocks.en: We organize the premature responses of streaming video LLMs into a three-way taxonomy, and identify consistent prematureness as a stream-specific failure that no inspection of the answer itself can detect.
blocks.zh: 我们把流传的视频LLMs的不成熟反应组织成一个三向分类法,并将持续的不成熟确定为流特定故障,无法检查答案本身。

blocks.en: We propose PACE, a training-free and model-agnostic framework whose checks match the taxonomy one-to-one, built around a self-revising watch plan and an auditable event ledger.
blocks.zh: 我们提议PACE是一个免费的模型不可知框架,它的检查与分类学的一对一相符,它围绕一个自我审查的观察计划和一个可审计的事件分类账构建。

blocks.en: PACE achieves state-of-the-art results on ProactiveVideoQA and OVO-Bench Forward across proprietary and open-source backbones.
blocks.zh: PACE在主动VideoQA和OVO-Bench Forward上跨专有和开源骨干实现最新成果.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Video Large Language Models.
blocks.zh: 视频大语言模型.

blocks.en: Modern video LLMs such as the Qwen-VL series and LLaVA-Video combine a vision encoder with a strong language model and are tuned on large video instruction corpora [ 2 , 48 , 1 , 44 ] . Their capabilities extend from temporal grounding [ 33 ] and user-generated-video repurposing [ 38 ] to intelligent image editing [ 34 ] . Parallel visual research preserves edge and frequency detail in remote sensing and MRI [ 5 , 8 , 3 ] , or organizes representations through hierarchical semantic alignment [ 52 ] . Agentic methods further plan frame selection and tool use over a complete video [ 26 ] . Most of these systems assume that the full video is available before generation, while several high-performing models are accessible only through black-box APIs. PACE instead considers frames that arrive causally in a stream.
blocks.zh: Quen-VL系列和LLaVA-Video等现代视频LLMS结合了视觉编码器和强语言模型,并调用大型视频指令公司[2,48,1,44]. 他们的能力从时间定位[33]和用户生成的视频重用[38]到智能图像编辑[34]. 平行的视觉研究保留了遥感和磁共振[5,8,3]中的边缘和频率细节,或者通过层次语义对齐来组织表达[52]. 代理方法进一步规划框架选择和工具在完整视频上的使用[26]. 这些系统大多假设整个视频在生成前即可提供,而几个高性能的模型只能通过黑盒API访问. 计算机设备行动伙伴关系则考虑在溪流中因果到达的帧。

blocks.en: Streaming Video Understanding.
blocks.zh: 流传视频理解.

blocks.en: Recent benchmarks report a substantial gap between offline and streaming video understanding. Models that perform well with complete videos often degrade when frames arrive incrementally, and withholding a response until future evidence becomes available remains particularly challenging [ 17 , 31 , 29 , 20 ] . One line of work incorporates streaming behavior through interleaved silence and response, streaming memory, system-level designs, or response-timing heads [ 4 , 42 , 12 , 43 , 22 , 30 , 28 , 23 , 9 ] .
blocks.zh: 最近的基准显示,离线和流媒体视频理解之间存在巨大差距。 配有完整录像的性能良好的模型往往在帧逐渐到来时会退化,在将来获得证据之前不予答复,这仍然是特别困难的[17、31、29、20]。 一行工作通过互留静默和响应,流体内存,系统级设计,或响应计头[4,42,12,43,22,30,28,23,9],融合了流体行为.

blocks.en: Training-free methods reduce inference cost through KV-cache retrieval and token dropping [ 7 , 41 ] , or schedule perception around anticipated evidence [ 18 , 39 ] . More broadly, adaptation has been pursued through feature regularization and label-free prompting [ 47 , 53 ] , selective vision-language subspaces [ 54 ] , cross-modal alignment [ 56 ] , and test-time prompt updates [ 49 ] . Analyses of in-context learning and SFT generalization further motivate flexible inference-time control [ 35 , 37 ] . Methods that explicitly model response release commonly use a decoding-time score [ 40 ] , a token-drop ratio [ 41 ] , or similarity between watch proposals and recent frames [ 15 ] . These signals do not explicitly encode question-dependent completion conditions. Online action detection estimates event boundaries [ 10 ] , but not whether the evidence needed for a particular answer is complete.
blocks.zh: 免费培训方法通过KV-cache检索和降标[7,41],或围绕预期证据的时间表感知[18,39],降低推论成本。 更广义地说,通过特征规范化和无标签促进[47,53],选择性的视觉语言子空间[54],跨模式对齐[56],以及测试时间即时更新[49],进行了调整。 对内文学习和SFT概括的分析进一步激发了灵活的推论时间控制[35,37]. 明确模型响应发布的方法通常使用解码时间分数[40],符号投放比[41],或者表建议与最近帧的相似性[15]. 这些信号没有明确编码依赖问题完成条件. 在线动作探测估计事件边界[10],但不包括特定答案所需的证据是否完整.

blocks.en: PACE is also related to test-time verification methods based on repeated sampling, consistency, or visual reinforcement [ 27 , 50 , 19 , 6 ] . Evidence-based approaches mitigate hallucinations or abstain when an answer is unreliable [ 32 , 46 , 13 ] , while complementary interventions target safety alignment [ 51 ] , jailbreak defense [ 55 ] , or removal of unwanted concepts [ 36 ] . These methods operate under a fixed context. In a stream, however, a currently supported answer need not be final [ 20 , 15 ] . PACE therefore adds constrained watch-plan revision, an explicit completion check, and an event ledger for verified observations.
blocks.zh: 计算机设备行动伙伴关系还涉及基于重复取样、一致性或视觉增强的试验时间核查方法[27、50、19、6]。 基于证据的办法在回答不可靠时减轻幻觉或弃权[32、46、13],而补充性干预措施则针对安全协调[51]、越狱辩护[55],或消除不必要的概念[36]。 这些方法在固定背景下运作。 但是,在一个流中,目前得到支持的答案不必是最后的[20,15]。 因此,计算机设备行动伙伴关系增加了受限制的观察计划修订、明确的完成检查和经核实的观察活动分类账。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Sect. 3.1 formalizes the problem and the error taxonomy; Sects. 3.2 to 3.5 then present the four stages of PACE shown in Fig. 2 .
blocks.zh: 第3.1节将问题和错误分类正规化;第3.2至3.5节然后介绍图2所示的计算机设备行动伙伴关系的四个阶段。

blocks.en: 3.1 Preliminaries
blocks.zh: 3.1 初步情况

blocks.en: A video stream is a frame sequence { f 1 , f 2 , … } \{f_{1},f_{2},\dots\} revealed causally: at time t t the system observes only the prefix f ≤ t f_{\leq t} . The backbone is a video LLM accessed as a black box, a function ℳ \mathcal{M} that maps a frame set F F and a text prompt p p to a text output ℳ ⁡ ( F , p ) \mathcal{M}(F,p) , decoded greedily or sampled; PACE interacts with the backbone only through such calls. A question q q arrives at time t 0 t_{0} , and the system outputs timestamped replies { ( τ j , y j ) } \{(\tau_{j},y_{j})\} online: at any step it may stay silent or emit a reply, and emitted replies cannot be retracted.

blocks.en: In our analysis of chunk-wise baselines, incorrect replies follow three recurring patterns: same-timestep resamples disagree because of decoding noise; a stable reply lacks support in the video observed so far; or a stable, supported reply concerns an event that has not yet concluded. These underlying faults can overlap in a single reply. For analysis, we therefore assign labels with a fixed decision tree, disagreement first, followed by support and completion, and give each incorrect reply the first applicable label.
blocks.zh: 在我们分析分块基线时,错误的答复遵循三种反复出现的模式:同时步骤再现因解码噪声而不一致;在迄今观察到的视频中,稳定的答复缺乏支持;或稳定、支持的答复涉及尚未结束的事件。 这些基本缺陷可以在一个答复中重叠。 因此,为了进行分析,我们先给标签加上固定的决定树、分歧,然后是支持和完成,并给每个不正确的答复以第一个适用的标签。

blocks.en: 3.2 Plan: a Self-Revising Watch Plan
blocks.zh: 3.2 计划:自我修正观察计划

blocks.en: When q q arrives, one text-only call ℳ ⁡ ( ∅ , q ) \mathcal{M}(\emptyset,q) produces a watch plan π = ( a , E , c , ρ ) \pi=(a,E,c,\rho) : answer type a a , evidence checklist E E , completion signal c c , and reporting mode ρ ∈ { rolling , final } \rho\in\{\text{rolling},\text{final}\} . State questions admit a current answer, cumulative questions grow until c c , and reveal questions become answerable only after the relevant evidence appears. Monitor instructions reuse these types and produce one reply per event instance. The question wording determines ρ \rho : definite totals and outcomes use final mode, while descriptive requests use rolling mode. The type and mode remain fixed throughout the stream.

blocks.en: PACE permits two plan revisions. Checklist items may be added to E E at any probe. The completion signal may be re-bound once, when the probe reports a setting mismatch and the scheduler detects activity in the preceding k k chunks. The replacement must be observable by the scheduler. Each revision and its reason are recorded in the ledger; all other plan components remain unchanged.
blocks.zh: 计算机设备行动伙伴关系允许两项计划修订。 任何探测器都可以将核对清单项目添加到E E中。 当探测器报告设置不匹配,调度器检测到前千块的活动时,完成信号可以重装一次. 替换必须被排程器观察到. 每次修订及其理由都记入分类账;所有其他计划组成部分保持不变。

blocks.en: 3.3 Attend: Perception-Gated Scheduling
blocks.zh: 3.3 出席情况:设想-时间表

blocks.en: The stream advances in fixed chunks, and a lightweight activity signal g t g_{t} , the mean absolute difference of consecutive frames, determines when to invoke the backbone. Quiet stretches are skipped up to a bounded maximum silence, while increased activity raises the probe density. Two signal sets serve different purposes. The probe-trigger set combines pixel and subtitle changes, with subtitles taken from the benchmark’s own track, and uses permissive thresholds to retain probes for dialogue-driven reveals. The corroboration set comprises motion cessation or a scene boundary after sustained activity and uses stricter thresholds to reduce completion triggers from isolated cuts in fast-edited content. For monitor questions, an onset is defined as activity rising above the probe threshold after a quiet stretch. These signals control probe timing and provide corroboration, but emission remains subject to the checks in the next stage.

Abstentions and drafts with no new information produce no output. Otherwise, the draft must pass the following three checks during normal operation.

blocks.en: If the stream ends before any reply is emitted, PACE releases the pending draft with the highest vote share. If no draft passed stability, it releases the last greedy draft. This fallback can therefore release a draft that has not passed all three checks.

blocks.en: 3.5 Emit: the Event Ledger
blocks.zh: 3.5 Emit:事件编辑器

blocks.en: Every emitted reply ( τ j , y j ) (\tau_{j},y_{j}) , event observation, and plan revision enters the ledger at the end of its probe. The ledger has three functions. First, it reduces duplication: drafts sufficiently similar to emitted content are suppressed, and an observation that overlaps an existing entry in time and cited frames is merged rather than added. Second, it supports counting: each observation that passes the stability and grounding checks becomes an entry whether or not a reply is emitted, and cumulative totals are read from the ledger rather than re-counted from pixels at every probe, a known difficulty in streaming counting [ 20 ] . Third, it retains evidence for subsequent probes and audit: cited frames from replies and entries form the evidence bank B t B_{t} , which uses a fixed capacity with oldest-first eviction, and each plan revision is stored with its reason.
blocks.zh: 每一份被发布的答复 (\ tau_{j}, y_{j}), 事件观察, 以及计划修改, 在调查结束时输入分类账 。 分类账有三个功能. 首先,它减少了重复:与所发布内容完全相似的草案被压制,一个与时间和引用框架的现有条目重叠的观察被合并而不是添加. 第二,它支持计数:通过稳定性和地面检查的每一项观察,无论是否发出答复,都成为一个条目,累计总数从分类账中读取,而不是从每个探测器的像素中重新计算,这是已知的流量计数[20]的困难。 第三,它保留了用于后续调查和审计的证据:从答复和条目中引用的帧构成证据库B t B_{t},该数据库使用固定容量,最古老的首次驱逐,每个计划的修订都按其理由加以储存。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 设置

blocks.en: We evaluate on ProactiveVideoQA [ 29 ] and OVO-Bench Forward Active Responding [ 20 ] . ProactiveVideoQA contains 1,377 videos and 3,510 reply turns from web videos, egocentric videos, TV series, and anomaly detection videos. We use its official PAUC metric with ω = 0.5 \omega{=}0.5 and the official GPT-4.1 judge. OVO-Bench evaluates repetition counting, step recognition, and clues-reveal responding with per-probe accuracy. We follow the official temporal settings for both benchmarks. ProactiveVideoQA uses 2 s chunks at 2 fps for web videos and 5 s chunks at 1 fps for the other domains. OVO-Bench uses fixed probe timestamps. At each OVO-Bench probe, PACE reports the rolling ledger count for repetition counting, the current state for step recognition, and yes for clues-reveal responding when all checks pass. Only the clues-reveal task uses the completion check, while model-drafted question types are evaluated only on ProactiveVideoQA.
blocks.zh: 我们评价的是 " 积极VideoQA " [29] 和 " OVO-Bench前进 " 。 积极VideoQA包含1,377个视频,以及3,510个来自网络视频,以自我为中心的视频,电视连续剧,以及异常检测视频的回复. 我们使用它的官方的PAUC度量衡,其中QQ=0.5\omega{=}0.5和官方的GPT-4.1法官. OVO-Bench评价重复计数,步骤识别,以及线索-启示响应的每个检测精确度. 我们遵循两种基准的官方时间设置。 主动视频 QA对网络视频使用2s块2 fps,对其他域使用5s块1 fps. OVO-Bench使用固定探测时间戳. 在每一次OVO-Bench探测中,PACE报告滚动分类账计数重复计数,步骤识别的当前状态,以及所有检查通过时对线索-启示响应的肯定. 只有线索-启示任务使用完成检查,而模型起草的问题类型只在主动视频QA上评价.

blocks.en: On ProactiveVideoQA, we evaluate PACE with Qwen2.5-VL-7B [ 2 ] , GPT-4.1, and GPT-4.1-mini. On OVO-Bench, we use Qwen2-VL-7B [ 24 ] , GPT-4o [ 21 ] , and Gemini 1.5 Pro [ 11 ] . On each benchmark the backbones are chosen among models with officially reported baselines, so every unwrapped number has a published reference. The default setting uses n = 3 n{=}3 , θ 1 = 2 / 3 \theta_{1}{=}2/3 , θ 2 = 0.6 \theta_{2}{=}0.6 , a re-binding window of k = 3 k{=}3 chunks, vote temperature 0.7, and greedy temperature 0. Maximum probe silence is 20 s and is reduced to 10 s for anomaly detection videos. Other thresholds, prompts, frame budgets, and evidence-bank limits are provided with the code. We run stochastic configurations with three seeds and report the mean. The main tables compare PACE with published systems and pair each PACE result with its unmodified backbone; all matched comparisons use the same chunking and frame budget.
blocks.zh: 在主动视频上 QA,我们用Quen2.5-VL-7B[2],GPT-4.1和GPT-4.1-mini来评价PACE. OVO-Bench,我们使用Quen2-VL-7B[24],GPT-4o[21],和双子座1.5 Pro[11]. 在每个基准上,在有官方报告的基线的模型中选择主干线,因此每个未包装的数字都有已公布的参考。 默认设置使用 n = 3 n{=}3, θ 1 = 2 / 3\theta _{ 1}{=}2/3, θ 2 = 0.6\theta _{2}{=}0.6, 重装窗口为 k = 3 k{=}3块, 投票温度0.7, 贪婪温度 0. 最大探测器沉寂度为20秒,对于异常探测视频,降为10秒. 守则规定了其他阈值、提示、框架预算和证据库限额。 我们用三颗种子来进行切片布局 并报告情况 主要表格比较PACE与已公布的系统,并将每个PACE结果与其未经修改的骨干对齐;所有匹配的比较都使用相同的块和框架预算.

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en: PACE lifts every backbone on ProactiveVideoQA. Table 1 shows consistent gains: GPT-4.1 improves from 53.4 to 59.3, GPT-4.1-mini from 55.2 to 61.0, and Qwen2.5-VL-7B from 41.3 to 47.1. The average gain is nearly constant, 5.8 to 5.9 points, although the three backbones differ in scale, family, and access, and the weakest of them benefits as much as the strongest. The wrapped GPT-4.1-mini sets the best average reported on the benchmark, 5.8 points above the previous best, its own backbone under the official chunk-wise protocol, and 13.8 points above the strongest purpose-built streaming system. The human reference row trails several systems, an artifact of live annotation latency under a metric that penalizes delayed replies.
blocks.zh: PACE 在主动视频上举起所有骨干 质检. 表1显示一致的成绩:GPT-4.1从53.4升至59.3,GPT-4.1-mini从55.2升至61.0,Quen2.5-VL-7B从41.3升至47.1。 平均收益近乎恒定,5.8至5.9分,虽然三个骨干在规模,家庭,和获取方面各有不同,其中最弱者得到的好处与最强者相同. 包裹的GPT-4.1-mini设定了基准报告的最佳平均值,比之前最好的高5.8分,它自己的主干在正式的分块协议下,比最强目的建造的流线系统高13.8分。 人类的参考行追踪到几个系统,这是在惩罚延迟答复的度量下进行活性注解的产物。

blocks.en: Where the gains land differs by backbone. For GPT-4.1 and Qwen2.5-VL-7B the largest improvements come on WEB and EGO, up to 7.5 and 8.3 points, where frequent activity keeps rolling answers current and the ledger suppresses repetition over long horizons. GPT-4.1-mini instead gains most on VAD, 9.2 points: anomaly clips reward a system that stays silent until the anomaly has run its course, and the completion machinery converts that patience into score. TV shows the smallest gains for GPT-4.1-mini and Qwen2.5-VL-7B, 3.4 and 3.6 points, and is among the smallest for GPT-4.1, suggesting that dialogue-driven reveals remain the hardest timing problem.
blocks.zh: 所得土地因骨干而异的地方。 对于GPT-4.1和Qun2.5-VL-7B,最大的改进来自WEB和EGO,最高可达7.5和8.3分,频繁的活动不断滚动的答案流,分类账抑制了长期重复。 GPT-4.1-mini相反在VAD上得分最多,9.2分:异常片段奖励一个在异常运行之前保持沉默的系统,完成机将这种耐心转换成分数. 电视显示GPT-4.1-mini和Qun2.5-VL-7B的收视率最小,3.4和3.6分,是GPT-4.1的收视率最小之一,说明对话驱动的披露仍然是最难解决的时间问题.

blocks.en: Table 2: Accuracy on OVO-Bench Forward Active Responding [ 20 ] . Published results are taken from the corresponding papers. The bottom block compares each backbone with and without PACE.
blocks.zh: 表2:OVO-Bench前进主动响应的准确性[20]. 公布的结果取自相应的论文. 底层块将每个骨干与非PACE进行比较.

blocks.en: OVO-Bench Forward shows the same picture. In Table 2 , all three backbones improve, Gemini 1.5 Pro from 57.2 to 63.4, GPT-4o from 53.4 to 57.7, and Qwen2-VL-7B from 48.7 to 51.5, and the wrapped Gemini passes the strongest published system, MOSS-VL-Realtime at 62.1. For the two proprietary backbones the largest gains fall on repetition counting, 9.6 points for Gemini and 7.6 for GPT-4o, the subtask that probes cross-time memory and the one the ledger is built for. The weaker Qwen2-VL-7B instead gains most on step recognition, 4.7 points, where the stability vote filters its noisier drafts. Clues-reveal responding improves on every backbone, by 1.4 to 4.4 points. The gap to human performance remains wide, 63.4 against 92.9, and most of it sits on repetition counting.
blocks.zh: OVO-Bench Forward显示同样的照片. 在表2中,所有三个骨干都有所改善,双子座1.5 Pro从57.2改进为63.4,GPT-4o从53.4改进为57.7,Qune2-VL-7B从48.7改进为51.5,包裹的双子座通过最强的公布系统MOSS-VL-Realtime at 62.1. 对于两个专有骨干来说,最大的收益是重复计数,双子座的9.6分和GPT-4o的7.6分,这是探测跨时间内存的子任务,也是分类账的构建目的. 较弱的Qwen2-VL-7B反而在步法识别上获得最多,4.7分,其中稳定性投票会过滤其鼻音草稿. 每个骨干部的Clues-reveal响应都有改善,提高1.4至4.4分. 与人类业绩的差距仍然很大,63.4比92.9,大多数都是重复计算。

blocks.en: Summary. Three facts hold across both benchmarks. PACE improves all six backbones, by 2.8 to 6.2 average points, under one configuration shared across backbones and benchmarks, apart from the domain-level silence bound stated in Sect. 4.1 . The wrapped systems set the best reported averages on both benchmarks. And the gains concentrate where each mechanism is designed to pay: counting subtasks for the ledger, event-bounded domains for the completion machinery, and noisy drafts for the stability vote. The strongest baseline also remains the strongest wrapped system, so PACE adds response timing on top of perception quality rather than trading one for the other.
blocks.zh: 总结. 三个事实贯穿两个基准。 计算机设备行动伙伴关系改进了所有六个主干线,平均点数为2.8至6.2,采用一个跨主干线和基准共享的配置,但节所述域级沉默除外。 4.1 (中文(简体) ). 包裹式系统为这两个基准设定了最佳报告平均数。 收益集中在每个机制用来支付的地方: 计数分类账的子任务, 计数完成机械的受事件约束域, 计数稳定投票的草稿。 最强的基线也仍然是最强的包裹系统,因此PACE在感知质量之上增加了反应时间,而不是将一个交换另一个.

blocks.en: 4.3 Visualization
blocks.zh: 4.3 可视化

blocks.en: Fig. 3 traces PACE and the direct chunk-wise backbone on two representative videos. On the rolling web video both systems follow the scene as it evolves, and their replies coincide while new content keeps arriving. They part ways once the scene stops changing: at 14 s the direct protocol produces another near-duplicate of its previous reply, whereas PACE finds that the draft adds nothing beyond its emitted replies and stays silent. On the anomaly clip the divergence is sharper. The direct backbone describes the explosion at 76 s, while it is still unfolding, so its reply names sparks but misses the smoke that defines the full event. PACE holds the same draft because no completion signal has fired, and emits one complete reply at 80 to 82 s, after the sparks and smoke have run their course. The two cases exhibit the two behaviors the watch plan distinguishes: rolling updates that track the stream, and a final answer released only once the event has concluded.
blocks.zh: 图3显示PACE和两个代表性视频上的直接块状主干。 在滚动的网络视频中,两个系统都跟随场景的发展,它们的答复恰逢新内容不断到达。 一旦场景停止变化,它们就分道扬镳:14时,直接协议又产生了一份几乎重复的先前答复,而PACE发现,草案除了所发布的答复之外,没有增加任何内容,保持沉默。 在异常点上 差异更大 直接骨干描述的爆炸在76秒,而爆炸还在进行中,所以它的回复名称闪烁但错过了决定整个事件的烟雾. 计算机设备行动伙伴关系持有同样的草案,因为没有完成信号发射,在火花和烟雾运行之后,在80至82秒时发出一份完整的答复。 这两起案件展现了守望计划区分的两种行为:滚动更新跟踪溪流,最终答案仅在事件结束后发布.

Each case shows sampled frames with their timestamps, the ground-truth replies with their reply windows, the direct chunk-wise replies of the backbone, and the behavior of PACE.

blocks.en: 4.4 Ablations
blocks.zh: 4.4 拖欠款项

blocks.en: Tables 3 and 4 remove one module at a time: the watch plan, each of the three checks, the plan revision, and the ledger. Ablations are run on ProactiveVideoQA with one closed-source and one open-source backbone, GPT-4.1-mini and Qwen2.5-VL-7B. Because all checks must pass before emission, multiple checks may reject the same compound error, so leave-one-out deltas are a conservative estimate of each module’s contribution. We interpret the deltas relative to the pattern predicted by the taxonomy rather than testing individual cells for significance.
blocks.zh: 表3和表4一次删除一个模块:表计划,三个检查,计划修订,以及分类账. 预告VideoQA上运行有1个闭源和1个开源骨干,GPT-4.1-mini和Qun2.5-VL-7B. 因为所有检查都必须在排放前通过,所以多次检查可能会拒绝同样的复合错误,所以留一出三角洲是对每个模块贡献的保守估计. 我们解释三角洲 相对于分类学预测的模式 而不是测试单个细胞的意义。

blocks.en: Table 3: Module ablation of PACE on ProactiveVideoQA with the closed-source backbone GPT-4.1-mini. Each row removes one module from the full system; subscripts give the change from the full system.
blocks.zh: 表3: " 主动视频 " 计算机设备行动伙伴关系模块的开发 QA与闭源骨干GPT-4.1-mini. 每行从全系统中删除一个模块;下标给出了全系统的变化.

blocks.en: Table 4: Module ablation of PACE on ProactiveVideoQA with the open-source backbone Qwen2.5-VL-7B. Each row removes one module from the full system; subscripts give the change from the full system.
blocks.zh: 表 4: 主动性视频PACE模块化 QA带开源骨干Qwen2.5-VL-7B. 每行从全系统中删除一个模块;下标给出了全系统的变化.

blocks.en: All modules contribute. Removing any single module lowers the average PAUC of both backbones, so the overall gain rests on complementary mechanisms rather than a single device. The two largest drops come from the watch plan, 3.8 points on GPT-4.1-mini and 4.1 on Qwen2.5-VL-7B, and the completion check, 3.9 and 3.6 points. Even without the watch plan, the remaining checks keep the system above its unmodified backbone, 57.2 against 55.2 and 43.0 against 41.3, so the plan is necessary for the full gain but not for all of it.
blocks.zh: 所有模块都作出贡献。 删除任何单一模块都会降低两个骨干的平均PAUC,因此总体收益取决于互补机制而不是单一设备. 两个最大的降幅来自表计划,GPT-4.1-mini和Qwen2.5-VL-7B上的3.8分,以及完成检查,3.9和3.6分. 即使没有手表计划,其余的检查仍使系统高于其未经修改的骨干,57.2对55.2,43.0对41.3,因此计划对于全部收益来说是必要的,但对于全部收益来说并不是必要的.

blocks.en: The completion check matters most where events must end. Its removal costs GPT-4.1-mini 4.8 points on EGO and 5.3 on VAD but only 1.8 on WEB, and Qwen2.5-VL-7B follows the same pattern with 4.2, 4.8, and 2.2 points. WEB questions often admit rolling answers, where a partial reply is already valid output; EGO and VAD hinge on event boundaries, where a model may describe the ongoing action correctly yet cannot fix the final count or outcome before the action ends. This asymmetry supports the central distinction of Sect. 3.1 : support by the current prefix does not make an answer final, and neither stability nor grounding substitutes for an explicit completion judgment.
blocks.zh: 完成检查在事件必须结束的地方最为重要。 它的去除成本在EGO上为GPT-4.1-mini 4.8分,在VAD上为5.3分,但在WEB上仅为1.8分,而Quen2.5-VL-7B则以4.2分,4.8分和2.2分遵循同样的模式. WEB问题往往承认滚动答案,其中部分回答已经是有效的输出;EGO和VAD取决于事件边界,其中一个模型可以正确描述正在进行的行动,但在行动结束前无法确定最终计数或结果. 这种不对称性支持了部门的核心区别. 3.1 :当前前缀的支持并不能使答案成为最终答案,也不能为明确的完成判断提供稳定性或基础。

blocks.en:
Grounding and stability follow the taxonomy. Grounding contributes 1.6 points on GPT-4.1-mini and 2.5 on
Qwen2.5-VL-7B, with the largest per-domain loss on VAD.
Stability contributes 1.1 and 1.8 points; its removal improves
GPT-4.1-mini on TV by only 0.2 points.
blocks.zh:
地基和稳定性跟随分类学. 基数对GPT-4.1-mini和2.5的贡献为1.6分
Qwen2.5-VL-7B,VAD的人均损失最大.
稳定性贡献了1.1和1.8分;其消除工作得到改善
电视上GPT-4.1-mini只得0.2分.

blocks.en:
The ledger and plan revision extend the gains over time. Removing the ledger costs most on WEB, 2.4 and 3.0 points,
consistent with its role in cumulative counting and deduplication.
Plan revision contributes 1.0 and 1.2 points, mainly on VAD and EGO,
supporting its role in correcting initial-plan mismatches.
blocks.zh:
分类账和计划修订工作将逐步扩大收益。 移除分类账成本最高的WEB,2.4和3.0点,
符合其在累计计算和减值方面的作用。
计划修订工作贡献了1.0和1.2点,主要是关于VAD和EGO,
支持其在纠正初始计划不匹配方面的作用。

blocks.en:
Weaker backbones lean on verification, stronger ones on timing. Qwen2.5-VL-7B loses more from every removal except the completion
check. This suggests that verification and memory benefit the weaker
backbone more, while completion remains important even for the
stronger model.
blocks.zh:
薄弱的骨干依靠核查,强的依靠时机。 Quen2.5-VL-7B 每次除完成外损失更多
检查。 这意味着核查和记忆对较弱者有利
完成工作仍然很重要,甚至对
更强大的模型。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: PACE combines training-free stability, grounding, and completion checks with an auditable event ledger, improving multiple backbones on two proactive benchmarks. Future work should reduce verification cost, diversify verifiers, and learn adaptive watch plans
blocks.zh: 计算机设备行动伙伴关系将无培训稳定性、地面和完成检查与可审计事件分类账相结合,在两个积极主动的基准上改善多个骨干。 今后的工作应减少核查费用,使核查人员多样化,并学习适应性的观察计划
